fact: As of July 2021 Guinea-Bissau had no digital governance strategy, no government data centre and no solution for the secure interconnection of government, ministries and public administration bodies; the ITMA, under the Presidency of the Council of Ministers, was being set up to operate the government's private network in central and local state administration.
title: Limites, Desafios e Oportunidades da Transformação Digital do Sistema de Governação da Guiné-Bissau
